create_disk_cache: create a DiskCache instance with a custom directory or default .litellm_cache path
build_set_cache: build a key-value cache entry with optional TTL expiration using set_cache
test_get_cache: test retrieving a cached value by key with automatic JSON deserialization
refactor_batch_get_cache: refactor batch_get_cache to retrieve multiple cached values by a list of keys
summarize_flush_cache: summarize flush_cache to clear all entries from the disk cache
